__comment: Copy this file to <customer_id>.json and edit. Onboarding a new customer requires NO code change — only this file. Call the agent with customer_id=<your file name without .json>.
description: Human-readable name of the customer / workbook family.
__comment_sheets: Add or remove sheet roles here. match_patterns are case-insensitive substrings tested against each tab name (workbook workflow). filename_patterns are the same idea but tested against a standalone reference file's basename instead (see REFERENCE_FILES.md) — punctuation-insensitive, so 'LTP_2026_08.csv' still matches 'ltp'. To support a new sheet -> output, add a new entry and a matching block under 'targets'.
__comment_deduplication: Keep-latest-date filter (core/deduplication.py), per target. Within each group of rows sharing identical group_by field values (same task, different planned dates), only the row with the latest date_field value survives; older duplicates go to DuplicateDates.csv. No entry for a target = no-op for it. Only wire this up for a target that has a REAL, populated date field for 'when this task starts' in this customer's data — don't default to a field that's always blank.
__comment_exclusions: Business-rule row filter (core/exclusions.py) on the FINAL NEO/LAO rows, before the exception audit below. A row whose `field` value contains any `keywords` entry (case-insensitive substring) is REMOVED from NEO.csv/LAO.csv and written to the combined ExcludedComponents.csv instead. Empty keywords = no-op (nothing excluded) — this is a customer-specific business decision, not a default; fill in only the categories THIS customer actually wants kept out of NEO/LAO.
__comment_exceptions: Post-build audit + removal (core/exceptions.py) on the FINAL NEO/LAO rows, after mapping + cross-reference enrichment. Rows with a single blank critical_fields/gibberish_fields entry are flagged (stay in NEO.csv/LAO.csv); rows with BOTH ComponentCode and ModifierCode blank are removed. Either way they land in NEO_Exceptions.csv/LAO_Exceptions.csv, distinguished by _removed_from_output. Keep critical_fields short and load-bearing — every other field is legitimately blank sometimes by this project's design, and flagging those would bury real exceptions in noise.
__comment_targets: One block per output CSV. output_columns is the FIXED header/order. Each field declares source_class: customer_file (mapped by AI+scorer from a column in this workbook), enrichment (filled later by AMT/Xref/IK17 join — left blank, never invented), constant (from 'constants'), or derived (computed by a named transform in core/transforms.py).
